question: Does loosening ERP bands add more useful stage-turning observation beyond the same price-state baseline and original 2sigma?
decisionUse: Low-frequency broad-index observation of stage reversal, not a trading rule or portfolio backtest.
sourceBoundary: CSI300 weekly PE source date +1 market-date alignment is inferred from calendar and 52 cross-source points, not proven timezone metadata. Weekly samples omit intrawweek crossings; index price is non-total-return and no PIT/cost/dividend handling.

signal.formula: X=100/PE_TTM-China10Y percentage points. Rolling 3 calendar years (t-3Y,t] including current; population std ddof=0; middle +/-2sigma. Strict first weekly upper/lower crossing after previous valid week not in same-side outside state. No event after missing or warmup until previous valid band row.
signal.availability: Signal known only after weekly close; outcomes start next CSI300 price trading close.
signal.adjacency: Current and prior row must be consecutive in qualified source weekly spine, each with valid 10Y/band; if calendar gap between source weeks >10 days, do not infer a first entry across an unobserved week. Current/prior bands must both be past warmup.

outcomes.entry: next trading day close at price index index i+1
outcomes.exit: entry close i+1+H, requiring complete H
outcomes.path: min and max close from entry through exit inclusive and offsets 0..H, both relative to entry close
outcomes.direction: upper expects positive return; lower expects negative return; directional metric sign*future return and directional success is sign*return>0; no top/bottom hit-rate claim.

priceBaseline.eligible: All valid weekly band rows with available price 63-day past return, 200-day SMA, and complete horizon outcome.
priceBaseline.B: past 63 trading-day price change <=-10%,(-10,0],(0,10],>10% x close>SMA200 boolean x <=2016 or >=2017; values known at signal close.
priceBaseline.controls: Primary: all non-entry weeks in the same current-time B cell, no future-event exclusion. At least 5 controls in a cell for common sample. Event and control return windows may overlap; 2-year cluster resampling addresses dependence imperfectly.
priceBaseline.supersededControlRule: Original +/-63-trading-day exclusion based on all future crossings is retained only in contract-pre-review.json; not run as primary or sensitivity because it is post-event selection.

uncertainty.clusters: Nonoverlapping calendar blocks 2008-09,2010-11,...2026-27; assign by signal week date.
uncertainty.estimand: Event mean and event-minus-all-week baseline, event-minus-matched-B-control on common eligible events; percentile 2.5/97.5, report valid and empty resamples.
uncertainty.limitations: Few blocks and repeat/overlapping events; interval is descriptive cluster sensitivity, not independent confirmation.

stability: worst counterexample and largest missed subsequent rise/continued decline
stop: One frozen core batch; no parameter tuning or new data. Finish with raw and incremental tables, uncertainty, exclusions, failures, reproducible files.
codeStandard: Python 3 standard library only; one script under compute, deterministic sort, fixture tests, input SHA assertions, finite numeric checks, no network.
oldResultBoundary: oldBandsCheckOnly is read exclusively for numerical cross-check; never import, modify, or use old outcome labels.

revision.reason: Independent pre-outcome method review: excluding control weeks within +/-63 trading days of any future crossing uses future event knowledge in control selection. Primary conditional comparison must use only contemporaneous B and current crossing status. Original frozen text preserved in contract-pre-review.json. No outcome run or result inspected before revision.

incrementExtension: For each looser first crossing, attribute at-signal abs(z) in [k,2) as earlier/milder condition; not claim independent new events. Report 63-session same-side cooldown; comparisons are descriptive, not causal or independent validation.
